Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. From Apple ID to Apple’s website to data centers around the globe, IS&T’s engineers, designers, and creators manage the massive systems and services that power Apple. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for employees and customers. It’s not traditional IT — it’s Apple’s central nervous system. From supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices to securing every transaction, download, and interaction, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.
AI & Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS&T's engine for AI-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning — including generative AI — along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.
In the GBI Finance team, we build the Reporting and Analytical solutions to meet business need for Legal, Management and Statutory Reporting. We use native SAP HANA to build these Financial reporting data models.

You will work as part of our HANA engineering team to build these financial models to report in a near real time at scale.

3 years or more of experience in Data Warehouse/Business Intelligence space.
Hands-on experience in Data warehouse development in SAP HANA.
Hands-on experience developing reporting and analytical solutions based on SAP data using HANA.
Hands-on experience Python and/or Shell scripting with a demonstrated ability to migrate mission-critical applications to cloud environments.
BS or MS Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong experience in Data Modeling, SQL performance tuning, and reporting, preferably using SAP HANA.

Do you believe intelligence can transform how people write, draw, and create? Are you excited by the chance to take Apple Pencil's intelligence to the next level? We are an applied machine learning team behind interactive intelligent features like Scribble, Math Notes, and Smart Script. We're looking for an engineer who can work from multimodal foundation models to on-device optimization, and who's passionate about shipping technologies that empowers the creative workflows of hundreds of millions of users.
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
In this role, you will participate in building the machine learning systems that bring intelligence to Apple Pencil. Your work will span perception and generation: understanding rich, free-form ink in its full multimodal context, and powering generative features that create and transform content from it. Expect to use both large language models and classical machine learning, applying whichever is right for each feature.
You will own problems end to end, from framing the interaction and prototyping on iPad with real Pencil input to measuring success and shipping, in close partnership with design, frameworks, and app teams across Apple. You will stay at the forefront of AI research to rapidly apply impactful developments, while pioneering new ideas designed specifically for Apple Pencil and Apple's ecosystem.
Design multimodal ML systems that combine ink with context to power intelligent and generative features.
Build evaluation for open-ended multimodal tasks, from automatic metrics to model judges and human evaluation.
Adapt, fine-tune, and distill models to meet on-device latency, memory, and privacy requirements.
Collaborate across design, human interface, framework, and app teams to turn prototypes into shipping features.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of industry experience building ML-powered product features, including hands-on work with multimodal models.
Experience taking an ML system from prototype through evaluation to deployment in production.
Strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one of Swift, C++, or Objective-C.
Experience with a modern ML framework such as PyTorch or JAX.
MS or PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
Experience with building agentic workflows and designing LLM-based evaluation judges
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency with agentic coding tools and workflows for prototyping, optimization and developing production code
Experience with generative models for images or other visual content
Experience with on-device machine learning, including quantization, distillation, latency and memory budgets

Are you passionate about search technologies and building knowledge experiences? The Answers, Knowledge, and Information team is at the forefront of revolutionizing how hundreds of millions of people use their devices to obtain information. We are a world-class team of machine learning engineers who collaborate closely with product, data science, and infrastructure teams to power and enhance features across Apple products, including Siri, Spotlight, Safari, Messages, and more. Our team operates in one of the most dynamic high-performance computing environments, managing petabytes of data and millions of queries per second. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you play a critical role in developing world-class search and Q&A experiences for Apple customers using cutting-edge search technologies and large language models.
As a member of our dynamic team, you will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to contribute to the development of upcoming products from Apple. Our team is responsible for delivering next-generation Search and Question Answering systems across Apple products, including Siri, Safari, Spotlight, and more. Therefore, we are seeking candidates with a deep understanding of large-scale search technology, machine learning fundamentals, applied machine learning experience, and strong software engineering skills. As Senior Machine Learning Engineer for the Search and Knowledge Quality team, you will be responsible for developing the ranking and retrieval technologies that power question answering and search across Apple products. In this role, you will collaborate with world-renowned experts in large-scale data management, machine learning systems, and knowledge extraction, driving advancements in question answering and search, as well as the underlying ranking and retrieval technologies. This is your opportunity to shape how people obtain information by leveraging your Search and applied machine learning expertise, along with robust software engineering skills.
Analyze search retrieval, ranking and relevance requirements, issues and opportunities
Design, train, and deploy machine learning models to improve search relevance and ranking.
Define evaluation metrics and benchmarks for search quality.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams including: product, design, and data engineering.
Find opportunity and partner with various product teams across the company to apply search technology to new product areas and use cases.

Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
7+ years of industry or academia experience in machine learning, with a focus on search, NLP, or recommender systems
Strong programming skills in C/C++ or Python, and experience with ML frameworks
Proficient understanding of search algorithms and familiarity with evaluation metrics for search and information retrieval
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Preferred Qualifications
Advance degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field
10+ years of industry or academia experience in machine learning, with a focus on search, NLP, or recommender systems
Familiarity with NLP/ML tools and packages like Jax, TensorFlow, pyTorch, etc.
Experience working with transformer-based models (e.g., BERT, T5) in a search context
Prior industry experience on large scale search systems
Ability to quickly prototype ideas / solutions, perform critical analysis, and use creative approaches for solving complex problems

Experience with C++ programming.
Experience with GPU programming via OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, DirectX, CUDA, or other APIs.
Demonstrated knowledge of the software graphics pipeline and its application to computer graphics and / or ML.
Exposure to debug of hardware and software issues in a GPU or CPU.
Exposure to continuous integration systems, automated build systems, and regression systems.

apple-200695783-3337.text:
At Apple, iCloud Platform Engineering builds the server stack behind Push Notifications, iMessage, FaceTime, iCloud, iCloud Private Relay and Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the backbone of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence. We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead PCC inference routing. These systems send every inference request to the right compute across a global, multi-region fleet, while keeping latency low, availability high and PCC's privacy guarantees intact.
This is a technically grounded leadership role for someone who thrives at scale, can bring clarity to complex and fast-changing environments, and is energized by building both systems and teams. You'll guide architectural direction, scale operational practices and develop the engineers and leaders who will shape how Apple delivers cloud inference.
Routing LLM inference at Apple's scale takes systems that adapt to changing demand, available capacity and failures while keeping latency low and accelerator utilization high. As the fleet grows across regions and cells, routing must account for capacity and health across the whole fleet, not just a single site. PCC adds a basic architectural requirement: request content stays encrypted outside trusted compute nodes. You'll lead the design of routing and scheduling strategies within this privacy model. Together with inference and security teams, you'll evaluate techniques such as cache-aware request placement and prefill/decode disaggregation. Your scope includes the inference AI gateway layer, where requests are authenticated, metered, prioritized and streamed back to clients, all without exposing request content.
This work has broad reach. Every improvement to routing makes Siri AI and Apple Intelligence faster and more reliable, and makes better use of Apple's inference capacity. In your first year, you'll be expected to grow a high-performing organization, set a clear technical roadmap, and measurably improve routing latency, availability and fleet utilization.
Direct the recruitment, development, and leadership for engineers and engineering managers responsible for PCC’s inference routing and request scheduling services, fostering an inclusive culture
Establish technical strategy with senior engineers, guiding architectural decisions and complex trade-offs in global traffic management, capacity-aware placement, load balancing, and failover
Translate organizational objectives into actionable roadmaps, execution plans, and measurable results
Oversee delivery of adaptive routing, admission control, prioritization, and overload management to maintain service responsiveness and share capacity fairly across competing workloads
Evolve inference AI gateway capabilities, including —including authentication, token-aware rate limiting and quotas, model and version routing, fallback and retries, and streaming response delivery—operating on request metadata to preserve end-to-end encryption
Collaborate with model serving and infrastructure leaders to assess prefill/decode disaggregation and cache locality optimizations within PCC’s privacy architecture
Develop and scale robust operations through observability, service-level objectives (SLOs), testing, safe deployment, and incident management in partnership with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Enhance efficiency via benchmarking and capacity-aware scheduling, leveraging queueing delay, latency, throughput, and utilization to guide investment
Provide senior leadership with transparent updates on team health, technical risk, and strategic trade-offs, converting complex technical issues into actionable decisions
Partner with Siri AI, Apple Intelligence, infrastructure, security, and SRE teams to deliver well-integrated routing capabilities
Minimum Qualifications
Extensive software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of leading teams that design, build, and operate large-scale distributed systems in production environments—whether through direct management, indirect oversight, or a combination thereof
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing engineers and leaders
Experience delivering API gateways (preferably inference AI gateways), request routing, load balancing, scheduling, or traffic management systems at scale
Expertise of LLM inference serving, including request routing, KV-cache placement and reuse, prefill/decode disaggregation, and the tradeoffs between latency, throughput and accelerator use
A record of shipping highly reliable systems in high-availability environments, including leading incident management, on-call and reliability practices
Strong technical depth: capable of contributing meaningfully to architectural and design discussions with senior engineers, with a server development background in Java, C/C++, Go or Swift
Ability to drive alignment and execution across teams in complex, matrixed environments
Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline or equivalent professional experience
Preferred Qualifications
Proven leadership in developing LLM inference serving or routing platforms (e.g., llm-d, NVIDIA Dynamo, vLLM, SGLang, or managed inference services)
Experience building or running inference AI gateways and their core behaviors: token-based rate limiting and usage metering, multi-model routing with fallback, retries and circuit breaking, and streamingresponse handling
Track record of scaling teams and organizations during rapid growth while maintaining top-tier hiring and engineering standards
Experience delivering capacity tiers, reservations or QoS for high-volume workloads, and improving accelerator utilization through cross-region, capacity-aware routing
Understanding of privacy-preserving system design: TLS, X.509, key management, Oblivious HTTP, remote attestation
Experience designing and maturing observability practices, including SLO/SLI frameworks, distributed tracing and on-call culture
Experience with container orchestration systems such as Kubernetes
Demonstrated ability to build psychologically safe, high-trust team environments that attract and retain top talent
Experience formulating multi-year roadmaps in collaboration with product, research, and senior leadership within large organizations that prioritize quality and reliability

Apple IS&T’s infrastructure powers billions of transactions every day. At this scale, the systems we build must be resilient, observable, and extraordinarily efficient. We are looking for a Software Engineer with deep expertise in Go and distributed systems to join our team and help build the next generation of Observability Platform.
Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production — managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software.
This is an individual contributor role where you'll take ownership of significant components of a mission-critical service, working with growing independence alongside senior engineers and architects to solve increasingly complex and ambiguous problems.
Our team is building an observability platform that supports some of Apple IS&T’s most critical and high-traffic services. We are designing a platform that must remain consistent and performant even as it grows to handle petabytes of data resulting from billions of daily transactions.
As a Software Engineer, you will contribute directly to the design and implementation of core backend services. You'll work alongside senior engineers to understand system architecture, take ownership of well-scoped components, and build the skills to tackle increasingly complex problems across the stack.
Build and maintain highly available, fault-tolerant components of a distributed system operating at petabyte scale.
Design and implement backend services and features in Go, with attention to performance, correctness, and operational simplicity.
Participate in technical design discussions and contribute ideas to architecture decisions.
Take part in code reviews and help uphold engineering best practices across the team.
Investigate performance issues and implement fixes and improvements under guidance from senior team members.
Collaborate with peers and learn from senior engineers through pairing, code reviews, and design discussions.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
12+ years of experience with OOP languages such as Java, Go, etc. with production experience building backend services or infrastructure components.
Solid experience designing and operating components of distributed systems — including replication, fault tolerance, and distributed coordination.
Hands-on experience contributing to systems that handle large-scale or petabyte-scale data workloads.
Good understanding of database internals — including storage engines, query optimization, and indexing strategies.
12+ years of overall experience.

The Apple Foundation Models team builds large language models that power Apple Intelligence. The pre-training group works on topics including model architecture, training recipe, optimization, and evaluation. As a senior software engineer on our team, you will be responsible for designing and building systems that support model training and pre-training research.
We build frontier foundation models that power intelligent experiences at Apple. Our team works across the full training lifecycle: including pre-training foundation models, and developing mid-training approaches that bridge general capability and task-specific performance. What makes our work distinct is that we're engineering models specifically for Apple silicon and optimized for experiences that are private, personal, and deeply integrated into the OS. We're solving frontier problems in reward modeling to resist reward hacking, handling sparse and delayed rewards in agentic settings, and aligning models reliably across the spectrum from open-ended creative tasks to precise, action-taking workflows. If you're drawn to hard problems where the research and the product are inseparable, this is the team.
Own the design, development, and operations of research and evaluation systems, with a focus on simplicity and reliability. In this role, you will build and maintain the platform through which machine learning researchers iterate upon model architecture and training recipes.
Partner with machine learning researchers and engineers to enable frontier research. You will work with researchers to expand the scope of what is technically feasible, and to facilitate fast experimental cycles.
Apply AI to the development and research workflow, such as developing agent and/or MCP systems, and AI-driven CI/CD pipelines.
Contribute and review code in large training and evaluation codebases. You will establish and uphold best practices with respect to code standards, and mentor junior engineers and researchers in terms of software development.
Design and execute autonomous agent systems for AI research and literature review. Work closely with researchers to identify core elements of pretraining research and develop systems that improve the efficiency and reproducibility of these processes.

2+ years of experience in software development
Strong software development skills, with proven ability to make meaningful contributions in complex codebases, and proficiency in relevant languages (e.g. Python, Rust, C).
Familiarity with LLMs, such as: model training, evaluation, and/or agentic systems.
Desire to design and build simple, robust, and scalable systems that facilitate machine learning research.

2+ years of experience working with machine learning systems, LLMs and/or agent frameworks.
Experience building LLM training and/or evaluation infrastructure.
Experience with public cloud infrastructure like Kubernetes, Amazon EC2 and EKS, Google Cloud Platform.
Familiarity with GPUs, TPUs, or other ML accelerators in the context of LLM training and/or inference.
Experience developing AI-based automation, including agentic workflows, AI-driven CI/CD pipelines.

Help hundreds of engineers build, test, and ship software with confidence.
We are looking for a Build, Release & Infrastructure Engineer to own and improve the systems behind our large, multi-platform C++ codebase. You will make builds faster and more reliable, automate releases, and maintain the on-premises macOS and Linux infrastructure that supports development and testing.
This is a hands-on engineering role: you will debug compilation and linking failures, improve CI pipelines, help drive our migration to Bazel, and work directly with compute fleets and lab hardware. You will partner with engineering teams across the organization and participate in a shared on-call rotation.
CI/CD: Design, maintain, and monitor pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, and GitHub Actions. Improve build and test turnaround through caching, remote execution, and test sharding. Diagnose recurring failures and eliminate sources of instability.
Release engineering: Own release automation, including versioning, code signing and notarization, security scanning, packaging, and artifact distribution. Partner with engineering teams to define and maintain release gates, including sanitizer builds, regression suites, and coverage checks.
Build systems: Improve our C++ build infrastructure and help drive the migration from CMake/Make to Bazel. Develop and maintain toolchains and dependencies to make builds reproducible and hermetic across supported platforms.
Compute infrastructure: Plan capacity and automate provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of macOS and Linux machines and VMs using Ansible. Improve fleet availability, utilization, and observability.
Lab infrastructure: Maintain racks, test benches, and hardware-in-the-loop setups. Work with engineering teams to integrate hardware testing into CI.
Developer support and incident response: Troubleshoot build, CI, release, and compute issues alongside developers. Participate in on-call, restore service during incidents, and follow through with fixes, documentation, and automation that prevent recurrence.
Minimum Qualifications
BS + 3 years of experience in build and release engineering, developer infrastructure, or a closely related DevOps role.
Strong understanding of C++ compilation, linking, and dependency management, with experience debugging CMake, Make, and Ninja builds.
Hands-on Bazel experience, including toolchains, hermetic builds, sandboxing, and remote caching.
Experience developing, operating, and troubleshooting production CI/CD pipelines.
Experience using Ansible to provision and manage physical machines and VMs.
Strong Linux systems knowledge and working knowledge of macOS administration, including Xcode toolchains, launchd, and code signing.
Strong Python and Bash scripting skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Clear communication, a collaborative approach to developer support, and the ability to prioritize effectively during incidents.
Experience migrating a large C++ codebase from CMake to Bazel.
Experience operating remote caching or execution infrastructure, such as BuildBarn, BuildBuddy, or Bazel RBE.
Experience authoring Starlark rules and managing dependencies with Bzlmod.
Experience managing Apple silicon fleets, including MDM and automated provisioning.
Familiarity with hardware test benches, serial consoles, and remote management tools such as IPMI or iDRAC.
Experience integrating C++ sanitizers, compiler caches such as ccache/sccache, or containerized build environments into development workflows.

The people here at Apple don't just craft products - they build the kind of wonder that's revolutionized entire industries! It's the diversity of those people and their ideas that encourages the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it!
The Postgres team at Apple is looking for an engineer to own how we build, package, test and release PostgreSQL, the world's most popular open source relational database. We maintain Apple's distribution of PostgreSQL - the core database together with a curated set of extensions, patches and companion tools for backup, high availability and connection management - and ship it to databases running on bare metal, virtual machines and Kubernetes that power some of Apple's most important workloads in Services, Manufacturing, AIML and many more. Every database in our fleet runs a build you produce. Your work will be deployed at massive scale, serving millions of queries per second over many petabytes of data across our data-centers worldwide and impact the experiences of many millions of users of key Apple services.
The Apple Postgres team develops and operates a highly reliable, cloud relational databases service that serves all of Apple. We're looking for a curious, enthusiastic and collaborative engineer with an extraordinary degree of care and rigor in engineering who will own the path from upstream source to production: turning PostgreSQL and its ecosystem into reproducible, secure, well-tested releases, and making that path fast and safe enough that the rest of the team can self-serve on it.
The role also requires excellent communication and the ability to partner closely with our Database Engineering and SRE teams, and a high degree of customer focus when engaging with internal customers. The ability to work effectively with colleagues based in other locations is also essential. Prior experience building or releasing database/storage systems is highly recommended.
Success in this role requires expertise in several of the following:
- Build systems and toolchains for large C/C++ codebases (Autoconf/Make, Meson, CMake,
GCC/Clang, LLVM), as well as Go and Rust projects
- Linux packaging and distribution (RPM, DEB), container images and base-image management,
and multi-architecture builds
- CI/CD and test infrastructure at scale, and release engineering practices: branching,
versioning, artifact management, staged promotion and rollback
- The PostgreSQL ecosystem: building extensions with PGXS, upgrade mechanics,
configuration, and the upstream regression test suites
- Software supply-chain security: SBOMs, CVE response, signing, and reproducible builds
Own the build and packaging of PostgreSQL, its extensions and companion tooling across multiple major versions, CPU architectures (x86_64, aarch64) and operating system targets, producing build artifacts and container images
Deliver timely PostgreSQL minor, major and extension upgrades, including security fixes on tight timelines, and run a predictable release cadence
Build and evolve the CI/CD pipelines that compile, test and promote every release - regression and TAP suites, major-version upgrade (pg_upgrade) validation, extension compatibility, and performance checks - through qualification environments into production
Make builds hermetic, reproducible and auditable: dependency pinning, software bills of materials, vulnerability triage, artifact signing and provenance
Partner with our Database Engineering, Platform and SRE teams to roll releases out safely across the fleet, and trace build, test and production regressions back to the change that caused them
Create the tooling, documentation and practices that let engineers add an extension or patch with confidence, and teach the team to use and contribute to them
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of relevant work experience
Demonstrates experience owning the build, packaging or release engineering of a large C/C++ codebase
Proficiency in shell scripting and at least one of Python or Go
Strong working knowledge of Linux, OS packaging or containers (Docker/OCI), including deployments on Kubernetes
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and artifact repositories
Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or another relational database
BS in Computer Science or work related experience
Preferred Qualifications
MS in Computer Science or relevant work experience
Experience packaging and upgrading PostgreSQL and its extensions, including major-version upgrades with pg_upgrade
Experience with hermetic or reproducible build systems such as Nix or Bazel
Experience with infrastructure and image tooling for cross-architecture builds
Familiarity with software supply-chain frameworks (SBOM, SLSA) and vulnerability management
Contributions to open source projects, especially in the PostgreSQL ecosystem

At Apple, we strive every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Our successes are the result of skilled domain experts working in an environment which encourages creativity, collaboration, and re-thinking of old problems in new ways! As a member of the Satellite Connectivity Group, you will work on the satellite network that enables connectivity to iPhone and Watch Ultra when off the grid without cellular or Wi-Fi coverage. Every day, Apple customers use Emergency SOS, Roadside assistance, and Messages via satellite to stay connected when they have no other means to communicate. You will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape this and other critical services, to the benefit and safety of millions of Apple device users.
The Satellite Connectivity Group is hiring a software engineer to build automation and runtime infrastructure behind our communication satellite network. Our premise is that a satellite network should be run the way modern software services are run — through code, APIs, and instrumentation rather than manual console work. You will sit on the seam between the satellite network, the cloud services that connect to it, and our operations partners that control it.
You will partner with hardware, cloud, and operations teams on root-cause investigations. You will carry the pager for the systems you build. The software you write will be foundational for a connectivity service for millions of users worldwide.
You will join the team responsible for developing, deploying, and keeping connectivity services healthy end-to-end. On a given week you might trace a telemetry discrepancy from a cloud service through the ground system, script a new network test case, extend the continuous delivery (CD) pipeline that ships system health tooling, and write the procedure that lets the on-call engineer resolve the same issue next time without paging you.
We expect the person in this seat to automate their own job continuously - to replace manual steps with tested code, and to leave behind procedures precise enough that someone else can execute correctly.
You will work from design documents and interface control documents (ICDs), and you will be expected to reason through large, unfamiliar codebases on your own.
Architect and develop mission automation software alongside our operations partners that enables lights-out operation of a satellite constellation
Be part of a 24/7 on-call rotation for those services; lead anomaly response and drive post-incident review
Author clear operational procedures for the mission that will be used by an operations team, interacting daily with the systems you build
Reason across large codebases, tracing behavior end to end to implement new features and root-cause issues
Work from design documents and ICDs to define and validate operations automation
Own continuous integration (CI) and CD pipelines for mission automation software services
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering
5+ years of software engineering experience, including production Python
Experience with developing automation of (preferred) satellite constellations or fleets of autonomous vehicles/drones
Ability to independently navigate and reason about large, unfamiliar code repositories spanning both embedded and cloud-based software
Hands-on fluency with Linux and Mac OS, cloud service APIs, modern command-line usage and HTTP tooling
Experience working with CI and production CD pipelines for a software service
Experience using design documents and ICDs as foundations for an operational service
Export Compliance Requirement: This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled technology and technical data regulated under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Applicants must be eligible to access this export-controlled information.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience operating a satellite constellation in production, serving real users
Embedded software development, and hands-on work with hardware in a lab environment
Working knowledge of RF and DSP concepts, sufficient to reason about satellite system behavior
Small, fast-moving space programs where operations engineers write and own the software they operate
Experience leading, or serving as a core member of, a 24/7 operations team
Building an SOP or runbook framework from scratch, not just executing an existing one
Experience leveraging AI tools to quickly reason about and prototype new systems

Video is at the core of nearly all Apple products, and as a research engineer on our team, you will build the infrastructure, pipelines, systems, and models that power the next generation of video technology. We are looking for a highly ambitious individual, who will flourish working on technically meaningful problems across the full ML lifecycle — including training infrastructure, performance optimization, data, and production deployment. Your work will redefine the video experience for billions of users.
In this role you will work together with colleagues to design, scale, and harden the systems that bring ML-based video approaches into current and future Apple products. This position requires a highly self-directed individual, who is comfortable working at the intersection of ML, systems engineering, and performance optimization. Strong engineering and analytical skills will be critical towards solving challenging problems across efficiency optimization, training, data, and deployment.
Design, build, test, and scale ML systems: training infrastructure, data ingestion and curation pipelines, power and performance optimization for inference, ML model development
Collaborate closely with team members and cross-functional teams to achieve quality, throughput, computational requirements, and robustness towards shipping the technology
Communicate: demonstrate the technology, present to leadership, share progress with colleagues, and so on

apple-200695239-0836.text:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. For decades, we've empowered creative professionals with industry-defining tools that transform how stories are told and brought to life. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
The Video Applications team continues this legacy, shipping best-in-class video products including Final Cut Pro, Motion, Compressor, and more. We're looking for a strong senior software engineer to help develop these applications and deliver the next generation of features that empower creative professionals worldwide.
As a Software Engineer on the Video Applications team, you'll design and implement high-quality features that directly impact millions of creative professionals. You'll tackle complex technical challenges across our video editing applications, working with cutting-edge frameworks and technologies on both iOS and macOS. Collaborating closely with engineers across the Video Apps teams, you'll contribute to initiatives that push the boundaries of what's possible in professional video editing on Apple devices.
Designing, implementing, and shipping features that solve complex technical challenges
Writing clean, well-tested code that sets the standard for quality and maintainability
Participating in and contributing to architecture discussions and code reviews
Working closely with cross-functional partners to define and implement features that delight our customers
Minimum Qualifications
BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
4+ years shipping production apps or frameworks in Swift, including Swift concurrency (actors, async/await, Sendable) and Swift 6 language mode
3+ years of experience of Objective-C and Swift/Objective-C interoperability
Strong understanding of software engineering and computer science fundamentals, including object-oriented design principles, design patterns, data structures, concurrency, performance and algorithms
Track record of owning a feature or subsystem end to end, from design through release at a high level of excellence
Proven ability to break down large features into practical, implementable solutions
Experience working on large, cross-functional, multi-team projects
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in a highly collaborative environment
Self-directed problem solver who can work independently and drive initiatives to completion
Preferred Qualifications
Customer focus and ability to make high-quality, user-centric product and technical decisions
Experience creating and refining APIs for adoption by other teams and developers
Familiarity with the server side of client apps, such as cloud services for sync, storage, or media processing, and how client and service evolve together
Genuine passion for professional creative tools and workflows
Familiarity with video editing, media processing, or graphics programming
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and release automation for large multi-target codebases
